title: Add SP8192 CaseOps + 2560 no-Q/V Adaptive Hedge n-gram (1.06083 BPB)
author: AidenGeunGeun

data.description: Uses the official SP8192 CaseOps token alphabet and an eval-time normalized token-level causal n-gram Adaptive Hedge scoring overlay.
Q/V LoRA disabled during eval-time TTT while K/MLP/O/lm_head remain active.

2560-token eval-time context with lower per-document TTT learning rate

Normalized token-level causal n-gram Adaptive Hedge scoring overlay over SP8192 CaseOps
